stories.headline: Bank of England Welcomes Government Plan to Drive UK Payments Innovation
stories.body: The British Treasury plans to give the Bank of England a new “secondary objective” to support innovation in payments technology and digital currencies, including stablecoins, Reuters reported Wednesday (Aug. 26). The proposed objective aims to ensure that regulation keeps up with changes in technology, and it would require the bank to report annually to parliament

stories.headline: Cook denies 'intentional wrongdoing' as Trump seeks ouster
stories.body: Federal Reserve Gov. Lisa Cook pushed back against the Trump administration's second attempt to remove her from the central bank over unproven allegations of mortgage fraud.
